BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the M1-2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 22-F in the area bounded by:

West 89" Street; a line 46.26 feet in length perpendicular to West 89" Street; a line 298.27
feet in length commencing at a point 46.26 South of West 89" Street; a line 188.75 feet in
length; a line 454.99 feet in length perpendicular to West 89" Street commencing at a point
191.70 feet East of South Yale Avenue.

to those of a M2-2 Light Industry District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 225 West 89" Street
